name: kanban
title: Kanban
description: Horizontal board of vertically-stacked KanbanColumns containing KanbanCards. Drag-and-drop reorders within a column or between columns; keyboard ArrowKeys + space cycles cards through columns per WCAG 2.5.7. Distinct from List (single column) and DataGrid (tabular). The board scrolls horizontally; each column scrolls vertically inside.
